avoid_dishes.dish: Breads, dumplings and courses with wheat wrappers

name: Avatara
questions: Can the full menu be made GF? Book with notice.
Is asafoetida (hing) in the dishes? It is often cut with wheat flour.
Do any courses contain quinoa or oats?
quinoa_oat_flags: Modern Indian tasting menus sometimes use millets, quinoa or oats. Ask in advance.

safe_dishes.note: OpenTable says GF diets are catered for on request

summary: A special-occasion vegetarian Indian tasting menu that adapts to GF on request. Give advance notice and ask about hing.
